notes: Initial N-14 (filed 2021-02-05) of The MainStay Funds: combined information statement/prospectus for the open-end reorganisation of MainStay Epoch U.S. All Cap Fund (series of MainStay Funds Trust) into MainStay WMC Enduring Capital Fund (formerly MainStay MacKay Common Stock Fund). No shareholder vote: 'The Reorganization does not require shareholder approval', so meeting_date is null and shareholder_approval is not a condition. A separate reorganisation of MainStay MacKay U.S. Equity Opportunities Fund into the same acquirer is mentioned, but the filing says this Reorganization is not contingent on it; n_targets=1 for this filing's transaction. Exchange at aggregate NAV (nav_for_nav). No tickers printed. security_class: share classes (Class A, Investor, B, C, I, R6) of an open-end fund; recorded as common, uncertain. record_date: Appendix E's 'Record Date' (March 15, 2021) fixes outstanding shares for the information statement, not a vote (there is none); recorded as stated, uncertain. conditions: board_discretion mapped from the Board's right to terminate (summary: if it deems that in the best interest of the Funds; plan s.12: if circumstances make proceeding inadvisable), a walk-away right rather than a closing condition; ric_or_tax_status from the required final dividend; 'other' covers reps/warranties and covenants. No outside/termination date is stated. Proposed effectiveness March 8, 2021 under Rule 488.
